method: Exact expectation under uniform reply selection and uniform target position. Context is 128 tokens; assistant header is four tokens. A target at offset 124 or later leaves no preceding-message tokens in the window. Earlier windows may retain only markers or part of the prompt; this is an upper bound on useful prompt presence.
inference: Reply starts receive little training weight and about half of windows cannot contain the preceding message. This is a possible contributor to weak prompt response, not a demonstrated sole cause.
